description: Marketing automation platform for email, SMS, and data-driven customer experiences
auth_notes: Uses private API keys via Authorization header (Klaviyo-API-Key) for server-side APIs, public API keys for client-side endpoints, and OAuth2 for tech partner integrations.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account, test without risk using test accounts, and generate private API keys or set up OAuth self-serve.
api_notes: Extensive REST API surface covering profiles, events, campaigns, flows, lists, segments, catalogs, metrics, webhooks, and billing.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Klaviyo yet.
rationale: Klaviyo provides a comprehensive, well-documented REST API with self-serve free developer accounts and standard API key/OAuth authentication.

evidence.note: Details private key authentication, OAuth, and public key authentication mechanisms.
Mentions starting for free and creating test accounts to obtain API credentials.
Comprehensive listing of REST resources like campaigns, flows, profiles, and metrics.
